'''Moonlight''' is the name of a horse in [[Tear]], riden by [[Nynaeve al'Meara]].

==Appearance==
Moonlight is a pure white mare.

==Activities==
Moonlight carries Nynaeve to the meeting between [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Hurin]].
